english.demandSummary: The Haditha–Aqaba strategic crude pipeline is intended to transport western Iraqi crude to Jordan's port of Aqaba at up to about 1 million bpd, as part of the longer Basra–Haditha–Aqaba system. Huawei can provide fibre transmission, remote pump-station communications, SCADA backhaul and cybersecurity.
recommendedHuaweiSolutions: Fibre/IP/MPLS backbone and resilient rings along the pipeline
Remote access and wireless communications for pump, valve and metering stations
SCADA backhaul, network isolation and industrial firewalls
Control-centre data-centre, backup and security operations
english.scoreRationale: 82/100 — long-distance pipeline operations need reliable communications and remote monitoring, aligning with Huawei's transmission and cybersecurity capabilities; cross-border execution risk remains high.
risks: The main contract has not been awarded and feasibility depends on intergovernmental coordination and financing; the route may overlap with the Najaf–Aqaba record; pipeline SCADA and leak detection are specialist-led.
nextActions: Manage this together with the Najaf–Aqaba opportunity as one strategic export corridor to avoid double counting; verify award plans, route permits and cross-border agreements; partner with EPC/SCADA integrators for telecom and cybersecurity sub-packages.
